integrity: Proof and all-cutoff estimates are analytic, supported by standalone exact rational finite regression checks. Historical sources provide the classical basis, not independent verification of this new bound. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The input consists of finite scalar harmonic degree bands on the round three-sphere, not arbitrary functions. The single normalized Clifford torus loses a nontrivial kernel for cutoffs at least three. The exact inverse norm is for the quotient/minimum-norm lift; general embedded tori, discrete point noise, and the largest eigenvalue have not been classified. Related general harmonic-trace literature may require further independent comparison.
title: Exact Clifford-torus harmonic trace spectrum and sharp exponential inverse instability
